newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KURO APARATURA POSTS 1.1 MLN LITAS H1 LOSS.
newsitem.headline: KURO APARATURA POSTS 1.1 MLN LITAS H1 LOSS.

text.p: Lithuania's Kuro Aparatura said on Wednesday that its losses in the first half of 1997 amounted to 1.1 million litas compared to a 14.8 million litas net profit in the same period of 1996.

"The losses stem from the fact that our clients pay us in goods, such as lubricants, cables or paper, instead of money and we were forced to sell them at a loss," the company's finance director Dalia Zhilinskaite told Reuters.
"In this way we regained at least part of our money," Zhilinskaite added.
The company produces tractor parts and exports around 90 percent of its products to CIS countries and many of its customers fail to pay their debts in time.
"At the present moment, our clients owe 52.1 million litas to the firm," Zhilinskaite said.
She also said the company's sales fell to 34.4 million litas in the first half of 1997 from 65.6 million litas in the same period last year.
Kuro Aparatura is listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
